actions.disposition_reason: Experimental engine rewrites routing with internal DRC retries, rollback and pour rebuild; its native effects and compensation residuals are not bounded by a verifiable public operation contract. Dry-run and mutation share this formal action; it is not advertised as a partially migrated success surface.

Native alpha clearRouting(net|connection) consumes implicit UI selection without an API that enumerates the exact destructive connection scope; the all branch also includes non-routing outline geometry. No complete target/residual contract for the full published action. Use native pcb.route.rip_up or pcb.route.delete.

Opaque SES/JSON import returns only boolean; no complete imported primitive identity/mapping or bounded residual report. Native ratline refresh is a separate effect. A trustworthy parser plus exact requested-versus-native mapping is required before qualification.

The documented Host import promise may settle when its confirmation dialog opens, before delayed component materialization. The dialog has no operation-bound identity and no native settlement/complete schematic-to-PCB mapping receipt. Count stabilization cannot prove completion or release ownership; full import requires Host qualification of a trustworthy lifecycle and mapping contract.

baseline_inputs: exclusive optional (bool, hide others when showing)
only optional (subset of components,routing,copper,regions,silk — omit = all)
include_geometry optional boolean (bounded native filled-copper evidence; freshness unverified)
project_uuid and document_uuid required with logical_ids
ruleType optional (name|number or list; default keep-out)
telemetry optional boolean: compact local geometry statistics; board or nets scope only, requires project/document identity
baseline_outputs: routingTelemetry optional: units, scope, board_revision, summary or nets[] with lineCount/lineLength/arcCount/arcLength/viaCount/totalCopperLength (lineLength+arcLength), netCount/routedNetCount/unroutedNetCount (board), positive-length-only netLengthDistribution, orientationHistogram {centerDeg,count,length} circular 15-degree bins covering lineLength only (arcs excluded), layerUsage; lengths are in-plane trace+arc centerlines, excluding via barrel/package/internal length and unverified delay

baseline_inputs: kind optional (via|track — refuse ids of another kind)
net optional (string or string[]); omit = all
spacing optional (coefficient, default 1.5 — scales label drift for assembly/solder room)
polygons (required: complex polygon = array of TPCB_PolygonSourceArray, each [x0,y0,"L",x1,y1,…] in mil)
mirror optional (bool, default false — horizontal mirror; auto-true convention for bottom silk handled CLI-side)
refs (required: []string — component designators to label, e.g. [J2, U1])
align_axis optional (x|y|auto, default auto) — x: vertical pin array, y: horizontal pin array
exclude_nets optional ([]string — skip these net names, e.g. [GND])
zone_rect (required: {left, top, right, bottom} in mil)
align optional (left|right, default left — left=left-to-right order, right=right-to-left)
exclude_nets optional ([]string — skip these net names, e.g. [GND, +5V])
expected_project_uuid + session_token optional paired guards (Go acquires when omitted)
client_transaction_id optional (Go generates when acquiring guards)
uuid (device-library uuid, not an instance id)
allPages optional (WARNING: non-active pages return shallow data — pins/bbox may be empty even when wired; switch to the page via document.switch for accurate data)
includePins optional (adds pinsAvailable and pinsError on failure)
includeDeviceIdentity optional (resolves instance ids to device-library uuids; unresolved parts report deviceIdentityError)
designator + pin, OR flagPrimitiveId, OR wirePrimitiveId (at least one)
primitiveIds optional (string or string[]; default = current selection)
